name: tripo-3d
description: Generate textured 3D models from text or images, add rigging and animation, simplify meshes, and export assets for games or 3D printing. Requires a mainland China Tripo account.

description_i18n.en: Generate textured 3D models from text or images, add rigging and animation, simplify meshes, and export assets for games or 3D printing. Requires a mainland China Tripo account.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用文字或图片生成带贴图的 3D 模型，添加骨骼与动画、精简模型面数，导出用于游戏或 3D 打印的素材。需使用 Tripo 国内站账号。
